sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Medocius was a British god. He is known from a single inscription found at Colchester. He may have been a local god of the land, a genius loci of the place. Medocius was linked with the Roman god Mars. Through that link he may have carried a warrior aspect, possibly as guardian of territory.
objective: Document Medocius, the British god known from one inscription at Colchester.
